name: Junior Volunteer Program
org: Florida Museum of Natural History (University of Florida)
what_you_do: In summer, teens work beside museum staff. They run a Discovery Cart or Discovery Zone and give exhibit tours to guests.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 17. You must be able to work on your own. Supervisors cannot always be there.
duration: Summer; selected teens may also serve in the school year
deadline_text: The program is suspended for Summer 2026 during a museum expansion. The museum hopes to offer it again for Summer 2027.
how_to_apply: It is not open now. To ask when 2027 forms open, call Volunteer Coordinator Amy Hester at 352-273-2055. Or send an email to volunteers@floridamuseum.ufl.edu.
notes: Return for Summer 2027 is hoped for, not promised. Confirm before planning around it.
